name: memory-recall-gate
description: Seeds engram + mnemosyne memory into context at session start and gates the first substantive decision behind an actual recall: the agent must call mem_context/mem_search (engram) and mnemosyne_recall/mnemosyne_recall_canonical before asserting remembered facts. One purpose: make stored memory get read, not just written. Reads the stores through engram's own HTTP routes and mnemosyne's sqlite file; touches no upstream code.
